async def run(items, width):
    size = 4
    size = 1
    for i in range(0, len(items), size):
        # ruleid: await-in-loop-python
        await asyncio.gather(*items[i:i+size])
    for i in range(0, len(items), width):
        if items:
            # ruleid: await-in-loop-python
            await asyncio.gather(*items[i:i+width])
        # ruleid: await-in-loop-python
        await other(i)
    for i in range(0, len(items), 1):
        # ruleid: await-in-loop-python
        await asyncio.gather(read(items[i]))
